report.title: Search is not case-idependent in non-EN locale
report.body: ### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Latest stable version (self-hosted) ### Memos Version v0.26 ### Bug Description Seems like the search is not case-independent when memos content is not in English. ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Create a memo: ``` **Рецепты** **Сырники**: **Блины** **Выход** 12-13 шт (большая сковородка), 12 - молоко 400 (500) мл ``` 2. Search for "блины" -> no results found. Searching for "Блины" (note capital Б) works fine though. ### Expected Behavior I expect search to be case-independent by default (and it seems to be working like this for English) ### Screenshots & Additional Context

steps: Create a new memo with the content: "**Рецепты** **Сырники**: **Блины** **Выход** 12-13 шт (большая сковородка), 12 - молоко 400 (500) мл"
Press Enter to run the search
plan.expected: the memo containing "**Блины**" appears in the search results when searching for "блины"
plan.reported_actual: Searching for "блины" (lowercase) returns no results, while searching for "Блины" (capital Б) finds the memo.
missing: assumed: the memo content is entered as multi-line text exactly as shown in the report's code block
assumed: the memo is saved with default visibility
assumed: search is done through the main search box on the memo list page
Which database backend is used (SQLite, MySQL, Postgres)? Case-insensitivity for non-ASCII may depend on it.
Does the issue also occur in the other locale settings or only with Cyrillic content?
plan.summary: Search for lowercase Cyrillic text doesn't match memo containing capitalized word

# Search is not case-idependent in non-EN locale

## Sign in
Sign in with username {{username}} and password {{password}}.

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:15304/.
Stay on localhost:15304 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do these in order:
1. Create a new memo with the content: "**Рецепты** **Сырники**: **Блины** **Выход** 12-13 шт (большая сковородка), 12 - молоко 400 (500) мл"
2. Save the memo
3. Click the search box
4. Type "блины" into the search box
5. Press Enter to run the search
The reporter says the correct behavior is that the memo containing "**Блины**" appears in the search results when searching for "блины". Verify that the memo containing "**Блины**" appears in the search results when searching for "блины".
